answer: Beacon spot-checks with a compute heartbeat stop identity farming. Each agent posts a 50 POA deposit; each epoch the beacon picks 5% and demands a heartbeat signal in 10 minutes, a 2-minute puzzle. An identity at its nadir that misses two checks loses its deposit; even a vertex atop the trust graph gets no exemption. Running 1,000 fakes costs 50,000 POA plus 50 checks per epoch; an honest agent answers one check in 20 epochs and keeps rewards.
